grammar_title: -ed 分词作状语(原因 / 时间 / 条件;-ed 与 -ing 的逻辑主语区分)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 1 Using language:-ed 分词作状语。逻辑主语为动作的承受者(被动)时用过去分词 -ed;干扰项为主动的 -ing、to do、谓语原形,使被动的 -ed 唯一成立。句子地道、人际关系/情感主题、零术语、应用型填空。

points.point: -ed 分词表原因(主语被…而产生情感)
points.overview: 当状语说明主句动作的原因、且主句主语是该动作的承受者(被动)时,用过去分词 -ed,相当于 Because the subject was done…。如 Disappointed by his behaviour, I told my friend everything.
当状语表示时间(when…)或条件(if…)、且主句主语是该动作的承受者时,用过去分词 -ed。如 Seen from afar, the statue looks alive. / Given more time, we could solve it.

points.point: -ed 与 -ing 作状语的区分(看逻辑主语主动还是被动)
points.overview: 状语的逻辑主语=主句主语;主语是动作的承受者(被动)用 -ed,是动作的发出者(主动)用 -ing。本组主语均为承受者,故被动的 -ed 唯一成立,而主动的 -ing 是干扰项。

questions.stem: ____ by his behaviour, I told my best friend everything.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 I 是'被…令失望'的承受者,用过去分词 -ed 表原因(= Because I was disappointed)。

questions.stem: ____ about her sick friend, Anna could not focus on her homework.
questions.explanation: Anna 是被担忧之事所困的承受者,被动逻辑用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by the silly mistake, he did not know where to look.
questions.explanation: he 被那个错误弄得难堪,主语是承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the loud noise next door, she found it hard to stay calm.
questions.explanation: she 是被噪音惹恼的一方,被动用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by the angry shout, the little boy started to cry.
questions.explanation: the little boy 被喊声吓到,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the unkind comment, Mary stayed silent for a while.
questions.explanation: Mary 被那句刻薄话震到,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by her warm welcome, the new student felt at home at once.
questions.explanation: the new student 是被热情欢迎打动的承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ with his apology, she decided to forgive him.
questions.explanation: she 被道歉所取悦,主语为承受者,用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ with the result, the coach praised the whole team.
questions.explanation: the coach 被结果满足,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the long argument, both friends just wanted to stop.
questions.explanation: both friends 被争吵弄得疲惫,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the mixed signals, he did not know what she really meant.
questions.explanation: he 被含糊的信号弄糊涂,被动用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by the bad news, he could not sleep that night.
questions.explanation: he 被坏消息所扰,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the sudden change, the children moved closer together.
questions.explanation: the children 被突变吓到,被动逻辑用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by her kindness, the whole class fell silent.
questions.explanation: the whole class 被她的善意惊到,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the old man's story, many readers were close to tears.
questions.explanation: many readers 被故事打动,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by his first failure, he almost gave up making friends.
questions.explanation: he 被失败挫伤信心,主语为承受者,用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by his teacher's words, Tom decided to say sorry first.
questions.explanation: Tom 被老师的话激励,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by the endless quarrel, she chose to walk away.
questions.explanation: she 被无休止的争吵弄得筋疲力尽,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by her warm words, the crying child slowly calmed down.
questions.explanation: the crying child 被温暖的话安慰,被动逻辑用 -ed 表原因。

questions.stem: ____ by the misunderstanding, he wrote a long letter to explain.
questions.explanation: he 被误会弄得沮丧,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ this way by a close friend, you are sure to feel hurt.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:主语 you 是'被这样对待'的承受者,用过去分词 -ed(= If you are treated this way)。

questions.stem: ____ in this way, the problem will soon be solved.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:the problem 被这样处理,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ from a distance, the two friends look very much alike.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:the two friends 是被看的对象,被动逻辑用 -ed(= When they are seen)。

questions.stem: ____ a second chance, most people will try to do better.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:most people 被给予机会,主语为承受者,用 -ed(= If they are given)。

questions.stem: ____ about the quarrel, he simply smiled and said nothing.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:he 被问到,被动逻辑用 -ed(= When he was asked)。

questions.stem: ____ the whole truth, she felt a great sense of relief.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:she 被告知真相,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ alone for too long, anyone may begin to feel lonely.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:anyone 被独自留下,被动逻辑用 -ed(= If one is left)。

questions.stem: ____ too quickly, a kind person may seem cold and distant.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:a kind person 被仓促评判,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ with his old friends, his new classmates seem much quieter.
questions.explanation: 时间/方式状语:his new classmates 是被比较的对象,被动逻辑用 -ed(compared with 固定用法)。

questions.stem: ____ a sincere apology, she chose to forgive him at once.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:she 被给予一个真诚的道歉,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ in front of others, even a calm person can feel angry.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:a calm person 被当众批评,被动逻辑用 -ed(= If criticised)。

questions.stem: ____ by his friend at last, he felt a heavy weight lift.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:he 被原谅,主语为承受者,用 -ed(= When he was forgiven)。

questions.stem: ____ by her parents, the shy girl slowly opened up to others.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:the shy girl 被父母鼓励,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ in time, we could have avoided the silly argument.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:we 被及时提醒,主语为承受者,用 -ed(= If we had been warned)。

questions.stem: ____ by those around him, a person feels safe to be honest.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:a person 被周围的人尊重,被动逻辑用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by his teammates again, he promised never to gossip.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:he 被队友重新信任,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ for something he did not do, he stayed surprisingly calm.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:he 被指责,被动逻辑用 -ed(= When he was blamed)。

questions.stem: ____ to the party by a kind classmate, the new boy felt welcome.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:the new boy 被邀请,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by good friends, we can get through almost any trouble.
questions.explanation: 条件状语:we 被好友支持,被动逻辑用 -ed(= If we are supported)。

questions.stem: ____ by the people closest to us, we feel much less alone.
questions.explanation: 时间状语:we 被最亲近的人理解,主语为承受者,用 -ed。

questions.stem: ____ by her own words, Lily wished she could disappear.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Lily 是被难堪的一方(被动),用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'令人难堪',与此处主语不符。

questions.stem: ____ about the school trip, the children could hardly sit still.
questions.explanation: the children 是被激动的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人兴奋'指事物,不指人。

questions.stem: ____ in psychology, she read every book on emotions she could find.
questions.explanation: she 对…感兴趣(被动感受)用 -ed;-ing 表'有趣的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ of the endless gossip, he decided to change the subject.
questions.explanation: be tired of 厌倦,he 是承受者,用 -ed;-ing 表'令人疲惫的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ to her friends, she always keeps their secrets safe.
questions.explanation: be devoted to 忠诚于,she 处于被动状态用 -ed;主动 -ing 在此不成立。

questions.stem: ____ about being late, Tom ran all the way to meet his friend.
questions.explanation: Tom 是被担心情绪占据的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人担忧的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ with the kind reply, she smiled and said thank you.
questions.explanation: she 被取悦(被动)用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'讨人喜欢的',与主语不符。

questions.stem: ____ at the rude message, Ben read it again to be sure.
questions.explanation: Ben 是被震惊的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人震惊的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ of saying the wrong thing, the new student stayed quiet.
questions.explanation: be frightened of 害怕,the new student 是承受者用 -ed;主动 -ing 不成立。

questions.stem: ____ by the long speech, several students began to look away.
questions.explanation: several students 是被弄得无聊的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'无聊的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by the constant complaints, she finally spoke up.
questions.explanation: she 是被惹恼的一方(被动)用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'烦人的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ at how kind strangers can be, he wrote about it in his diary.
questions.explanation: he 是被惊叹打动的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人惊叹的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by his mixed signals, Mary asked him to explain clearly.
questions.explanation: Mary 是被弄糊涂的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人困惑的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ with his honest answer, the teacher nodded and smiled.
questions.explanation: the teacher 被满足(被动)用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'令人满意的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ in himself, he promised to think before speaking next time.
questions.explanation: he 对自己失望(被动感受)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人失望的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by the angry voices, the small dog hid under the table.
questions.explanation: the small dog 是被吓到的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'吓人的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by the sudden apology, she did not know what to say.
questions.explanation: she 是被惊到的一方(被动)用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'令人惊讶的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by her friend's support, she felt warm inside.
questions.explanation: she 被打动(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'动人的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ after the long argument, both of them wanted some quiet.
questions.explanation: both of them 是被累垮的一方(被动)用 -ed;-ing 表'令人疲惫的'指事物。

questions.stem: ____ by the old fable, the class talked about keeping a good distance.
questions.explanation: the class 被寓言启发(被动)用 -ed;主动的 -ing 表'鼓舞人心的'指事物。
